==Biography==

===2016 Season===
'''Chorong''' joined NA Challenger team [[Astral Authority]] for the [[NA Challenger Series/2016 Season/Spring Qualifiers/Open Qualifier|NACS Open Qualifier]]. The team made it to the [[NA Challenger Series/2016 Season/Spring Qualifiers|final qualifier round]], renaming to [[Samadder Gaming]]. After qualifying, the team renamed to [[Dream Team]]. Dream Team finished the season in fifth place, losing an automatic tiebreaker with [[Team Liquid Academy]] due to head-to-head record. They missed out on the [[NA Challenger Series/2016 Season/Spring Playoffs|playoffs]] but received higher seeding for the [[NA Challenger Series/2016 Season/Summer Qualifiers|summer qualifier]] due to finishing ahead of [[Enemy]].

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''AnDa''' is a reference to ''StarCraft'' player NaDa and his own name (Andy).
* His previous ID '''Chorong''' comes from [[wikipedia:en:Apink|Apink]] member Park Cho-rong.
* Is the cousin of [[Balls]].
* Achieved Global Elite rank in ''CS:GO''.
